title: Daily Digest A: Injury Watch (Sun Nov 22)
parts:
🩹 DEVYDOSE INJURY WATCH | Sun, Nov 22

Saturday took a toll: Kentucky's top-10 RB left Missouri on crutches, North Carolina's No. 6 TE exited in pain, Indiana's No. 16 WR took a late hit, and UCLA's QB was carted off in overtime 🧵👇

🩹 CJ BAXTER JR. | Kentucky | SR, 5⭐ | #7 RB

Ruled out at Missouri, then left on crutches in a walking boot (via A Sea of Blue).

🩹 Jelani Thurman | North Carolina | SR, 4⭐ | #6 TE: left the Virginia game with an apparent arm injury (via RotoWire).

🩹 NICK MARSH | Indiana | JR, 4⭐ | #16 WR

Took a late hit to the ribs and did not return in overtime (via The Daily Hoosier).

✅ Anthony Evans III | Mississippi State | SR, 4⭐ | #28 WR: twisted an ankle. Jeff Lebby: "He's going to be fine" (via Clarion Ledger).

🩹 Ty Dieffenbach | UCLA | SR, 3⭐ | #519 QB: carted off on a stretcher in overtime at Michigan (via Yahoo Sports).

Madden Iamaleava | UCLA | SO | #395 QB replaced him.

Which of these hurts your roster most? 👇
